rx_total;125static volatile uint32_t tx_total;126static volatile uint8_t ep_tx_busy_flag;127static volatile uint8_t dtr_enable;128static volatile uint8_t usb_configured;129static uint8_t banner_sent;130 131static const char banner[] =132    "
=== STM32F103 CherryUSB CDC ACM (etm-trace target) ===
"133    "commands: PING | INFO | MARK | ECHO on|off | ECHO <text>
";134 135/* ======================= USB 事件回调 =======================136 * 回调只更新标志；队列与接收缓冲由主循环在临界区里统一处理（见 cdc_poll）。 */137static void cdc_session_reset(void)138{139    usb_configured = 0;140    dtr_enable = 0;141    rx_pending = rx_armed = 0;142    rx_len = rx_processed = 0;143    ep_tx_busy_flag = banner_sent = 0;144    cdc_console_reset();145}146 147static void usbd_event_handler(uint8_t busid, uint8_t event)148{149    (void)busid;150    switch (event) {151        case USBD_EVENT_RESET:152            cdc_session_reset();153            USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] reset
");154            break;155        case USBD_EVENT_CONNECTED:156            USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] connected
");157            break;158        case USBD_EVENT_DISCONNECTED:159            cdc_session_reset();160            USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] disconnected
");161            break;162        case USBD_EVENT_RESUME:163        case USBD_EVENT_SUSPEND:164            break;165        case USBD_EVENT_CONFIGURED:166            cdc_session_reset();167            usb_configured = 1;168            USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] configured
");169            break;170        case USBD_EVENT_SET_REMOTE_WAKEUP:171        case USBD_EVENT_CLR_REMOTE_WAKEUP:172            break;173        default:174            break;175    }176}177 178void usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_out(uint8_t busid, uint8_t ep, uint32_t nbytes)179{180    (void)busid;181    (void)ep;182    rx_armed = 0;183    rx_len = nbytes;184    rx_processed = 0;185    rx_pending = 1;186    rx_total += nbytes;187    g_trace.usb_rx = rx_total;188    /* 主循环处理完这包才重新接收；TX 满时通过 OUT NAK 施加背压。 */189}190 191void usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_in(uint8_t busid, uint8_t ep, uint32_t nbytes)192{193    tx_total += nbytes;194    g_trace.usb_tx = tx_total;195 196    uint16_t mps = usbd_get_ep_mps(busid, ep);197    if (usb_configured && mps && nbytes && (nbytes % mps) == 0) {198        /* 整包后补 ZLP；ZLP 完成前保持忙标志。 */199        if (usbd_ep_start_write(busid, CDC_IN_EP, NULL, 0) != 0) {200            ep_tx_busy_flag = 0;201        }202    } else {203        ep_tx_busy_flag = 0;204    }205}206 207static struct usbd_endpoint cdc_out_ep = { .ep_addr = CDC_OUT_EP, .ep_cb = usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_out };208static struct usbd_endpoint cdc_in_ep = { .ep_addr = CDC_IN_EP, .ep_cb = usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_in };209static struct usbd_interface intf0;210static struct usbd_interface intf1;211 212/* CDC 类请求回调（模板里是 __WEAK，这里给真实实现） */213void usbd_cdc_acm_set_dtr(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool dtr)214{215    (void)busid;216    (void)intf;217    dtr_enable = dtr ? 1 : 0;218    if (!dtr) {219        /* 关闭串口：清命令行和待发队列，再次打开时重新发欢迎信息。 */220        cdc_console_reset();221        rx_processed = rx_len;222        banner_sent = 0;223    }224}225 226void usbd_cdc_acm_set_rts(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool rts)227{228    (void)busid;229    (void)intf;230    (void)rts;231}232 233static int cdc_acm_init(uint8_t busid, uintptr_t reg_base)234{235    usbd_desc_register(busid, &cdc_descriptor);236    usbd_add_interface(busid, usbd_cdc_acm_init_intf(busid, &intf0));237    usbd_add_interface(busid, usbd_cdc_acm_init_intf(busid, &intf1));238    usbd_add_endpoint(busid, &cdc_out_ep);239    usbd_add_endpoint(busid, &cdc_in_ep);240 241    cdc_session_reset();242    /* 内部会调 usb_dc_init() → usb_dc_low_level_init()，243     * 后者在 usb_glue_st.c 里走 HAL_PCD_MspInit 开时钟与中断。 */244    return usbd_initialize(busid, reg_base, usbd_event_handler);245}246 247/* ======================= 主循环收发 =======================248 * 调用前必须关中断（见 cdc_poll），与 USB 回调串行化对队列和缓冲的所有权。 */249static void cdc_tx_poll(void)250{251    if (!usb_configured || !dtr_enable || ep_tx_busy_flag) {252        return;253    }254    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)cdc_console_peek(write_buffer, sizeof(write_buffer));255    if (n) {256        ep_tx_busy_flag = 1;257        if (usbd_ep_start_write(0, CDC_IN_EP, write_buffer, n) == 0) {258            cdc_console_consume(n);259        } else {260            ep_tx_busy_flag = 0; /* 保留队列数据，下次重试 */261        }262    }263}264 265static void cdc_poll(void)266{267    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();268    __disable_irq();269 270    /* 每次只解析一包 64 字节，主循环里不做等待或 RTT 日志。 */271    if (usb_configured && !usb_device_is_configured(0)) {272        cdc_session_reset(); /* SET_CONFIGURATION(0) 不会触发回调 */273    }274    if (usb_configured) {275        cdc_tx_poll();276        if (dtr_enable && !banner_sent &&277            cdc_console_write((const uint8_t *)banner, sizeof(banner) - 1u)) {278            banner_sent = 1;279        }280        if (rx_pending) {281            if (dtr_enable) {282                rx_processed += (uint32_t)cdc_console_feed(283                    read_buffer + rx_processed, rx_len - rx_processed);284            } else {285                rx_processed = rx_len;286            }287            if (rx_processed == rx_len) {288                rx_pending = 0;289            }290        }291        if (!rx_pending && !rx_armed) {292            if (usbd_ep_start_read(0, CDC_OUT_EP, read_buffer, CDC_MAX_MPS) == 0) {293                rx_armed = 1;294            }295        }296        cdc_tx_poll();297    }298    __set_PRIMASK(primask);299}300 301/* ======================= CDC 命令行（协议由 cdc_console.c 负责）=======================302 * 板级回调：INFO 字段与 H7B0 不同（F103 没有 TRACECLK）。303 * usbhp/ctr 用于排查枚举；RESET/ERR/SUSP 走 LP 向量，本工程不计数（见 trace_hooks.h）。 */304size_t cdc_console_info(char *out, size_t capacity)305{306    int n = snprintf(out, capacity,307                     "chip=STM32F103 sysclk=%luHz clk_err=%lu loops=%lu marks=%lu rx=%lu tx=%lu "308                     "usbhp=%lu ctr=%lu
",309                     (unsigned long)g_sysclk_hz, (unsigned long)g_clock_err,310                     (unsigned long)g_trace.loops, (unsigned long)g_trace.marks,311                     (unsigned long)rx_total, (unsigned long)tx_total,312                     (unsigned long)g_trace.usb_hp_irq, (unsigned long)g_trace.usb_ctr);313    return n > 0 ? (size_t)n : 0u;314}315 316void cdc_console_mark(void)317{318    trace_hook_mark();319}320 321/* ======================= 时钟 / 外设初始化（沿用参考工程） ======================= */322void SystemClock_Config(void)323{324    RCC_OscInitTypeDef RCC_OscInitStruct = { 0 };325    RCC_ClkInitTypeDef RCC_ClkInitStruct = { 0 };326    RCC_PeriphCLKInitTypeDef PeriphClkInit = { 0 };327 328    /* F103ZE defaults to PLL6: CPU/HCLK 48 MHz, TRACECLK 24 MHz, USB 48 MHz.329     * PLL9 remains available as an explicit 72/36 MHz comparison build. */330    RCC_OscInitStruct.OscillatorType = RCC_OSCILLATORTYPE_HSE;331    RCC_OscInitStruct.HSEState = RCC_HSE_ON;332    RCC_OscInitStruct.HSEPredivValue = RCC_HSE_PREDIV_DIV1;333    RCC_OscInitStruct.HSIState = RCC_HSI_ON;334    RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLState = RCC_PLL_ON;335    RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLSource = RCC_PLLSOURCE_HSE;336#if defined(TRACE_CPU_48MHZ) || defined(TRACE_CPU_24MHZ)337    RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLMUL = RCC_PLL_MUL6;338#else339    RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLMUL = RCC_PLL_MUL9;340#endif341    if (HAL_RCC_OscConfig(&RCC_OscInitStruct) != HAL_OK) {342        g_clock_err |= 1u;343    }344 345    RCC_ClkInitStruct.ClockType = RCC_CLOCKTYPE_HCLK | RCC_CLOCKTYPE_SYSCLK |346                                  RCC_CLOCKTYPE_PCLK1 | RCC_CLOCKTYPE_PCLK2;347    RCC_ClkInitStruct.SYSCLKSource = RCC_SYSCLKSOURCE_PLLCLK;348#ifdef TRACE_CPU_24MHZ349    RCC_ClkInitStruct.AHBCLKDivider = RCC_SYSCLK_DIV2; /* PLL48 retains USB48, CPU24/TRACECLK12. */350#else351    RCC_ClkInitStruct.AHBCLKDivider = RCC_SYSCLK_DIV1;352#endif353    RCC_ClkInitStruct.APB1CLKDivider = RCC_HCLK_DIV2;354    RCC_ClkInitStruct.APB2CLKDivider = RCC_HCLK_DIV1;355#ifdef TRACE_CPU_24MHZ356    if (HAL_RCC_ClockConfig(&RCC_ClkInitStruct, FLASH_LATENCY_0) != HAL_OK) {357#elif defined(TRACE_CPU_48MHZ)358    if (HAL_RCC_ClockConfig(&RCC_ClkInitStruct, FLASH_LATENCY_1) != HAL_OK) {359#else360    if (HAL_RCC_ClockConfig(&RCC_ClkInitStruct, FLASH_LATENCY_2) != HAL_OK) {361#endif362        g_clock_err |= 2u;363    }364 365    /* USB 时钟固定为 48 MHz：72 MHz 档 PLL /1.5，48 MHz 档 PLL /1。 */366    PeriphClkInit.PeriphClockSelection = RCC_PERIPHCLK_USB;367#if defined(TRACE_CPU_48MHZ) || defined(TRACE_CPU_24MHZ)368    PeriphClkInit.UsbClockSelection = RCC_USBCLKSOURCE_PLL;369#else370    PeriphClkInit.UsbClockSelection = RCC_USBCLKSOURCE_PLL_DIV1_5;371#endif372    if (HAL_RCCEx_PeriphCLKConfig(&PeriphClkInit) != HAL_OK) {373        g_clock_err |= 4u;374    }375 376    g_sysclk_hz = HAL_RCC_GetHCLKFreq();377}378 379static void MX_GPIO_Init(void)380{381    GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct = { 0 };382 383    __HAL_RCC_GPIOA_CLK_ENABLE();384    __HAL_RCC_GPIOB_CLK_ENABLE();385 386#if defined(STM32F103xE)387    /* Parallel ETM trace output: PE2=TRACECLK, PE3..PE6=TRACED0..3.388     * These pins reset as floating inputs.  DBGMCU_CR selects the trace389     * function later, but the GPIO output stages must be configured here.390     * Keep this independent of the host's ETM/TPIU enable sequence. */391    __HAL_RCC_GPIOE_CLK_ENABLE();392    GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_2 | GPIO_PIN_3 | GPIO_PIN_4 |393                          GPIO_PIN_5 | GPIO_PIN_6;394    GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_AF_PP;395    GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;396    GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_HIGH; /* F1: 50 MHz output mode */397    HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOE, &GPIO_InitStruct);398#endif399 400    /* PA0：保留参照工程的输入脚（不驱动，避免与板级跳线冲突）。401     * PA1：trace 打点脚，由 trace_hooks.c 初始化为推挽输出。 */402    GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_0;403    GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_INPUT;404    GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_PULLDOWN;405    GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_HIGH;406    HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOA, &GPIO_InitStruct);407 408    /* PB2：参照工程的状态输出脚，保留以免板级行为变化。 */409    GPIO_InitStruct.Pin = GPIO_PIN_2;410    GPIO_InitStruct.Mode = GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT_PP;411    GPIO_InitStruct.Pull = GPIO_NOPULL;412    GPIO_InitStruct.Speed = GPIO_SPEED_FREQ_HIGH;413    HAL_GPIO_Init(GPIOB, &GPIO_InitStruct);414}415 416static void MX_USART1_UART_Init(void)417{418    huart1.Instance = USART1;419    huart1.Init.BaudRate = 115200;420    huart1.Init.WordLength = UART_WORDLENGTH_8B;421    huart1.Init.StopBits = UART_STOPBITS_1;422    huart1.Init.Parity = UART_PARITY_NONE;423    huart1.Init.Mode = UART_MODE_TX_RX;424    huart1.Init.HwFlowCtl = UART_HWCONTROL_NONE;425    if (HAL_UART_Init(&huart1) != HAL_OK) {426        g_clock_err |= 8u;427    }428}429 430/* ======================= main ======================= */431int main(void)432{433    HAL_Init();434    SystemClock_Config();435    SystemCoreClockUpdate();436    MX_GPIO_Init();437    MX_USART1_UART_Init();438 439    SEGGER_RTT_Init();440    trace_log_printf("
=== STM32F103 CDC ACM (CherryUSB) ===
");441    trace_log_printf("SYSCLK=%lu Hz, HCLK=%lu Hz, clock_err=%lu
",442                     (unsigned long)HAL_RCC_GetSysClockFreq(),443                     (unsigned long)HAL_RCC_GetHCLKFreq(),444                     (unsigned long)g_clock_err);445 446    trace_hook_init();447    trace_hook_entry();448 449    (void)cdc_acm_init(0, (uintptr_t)USB_BASE);450    trace_log_printf("usb initialized (USB_BASE=0x%08lx)
", (unsigned long)USB_BASE);451 452    trace_hook_ready();453 454    for (;;) {455        g_trace.loops++;456 457        /* 每轮只处理一包；RTT 日志与 USB 回调互不阻塞。 */458        cdc_poll();459 460#ifdef TRACE_PATH_WORKLOAD461        trace_workload_round(g_trace.loops);462#endif463 464        if ((g_trace.loops & 0xFFFFFu) == 0u) {465            trace_hook_mark();466        }467    }468}469
